description: Unsigned transactions to post gAIX as collateral and borrow USDG against it, from the wallet: approve gAIX to Morpho for exactly what is posted (when needed), post it, borrow. post and amount can each be given alone (post more to an open loan; borrow more against what is posted). Borrowing pauses every weekend and whenever a basket price is out of date (posting does not), and stops at three quarters of the limit. Simulated from the wallet.

amount.description: USDG to borrow, as a decimal string, like "250"

post.description: gAIX to post, in whole shares as a decimal string, like "10"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
